{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    edges = case['edges']
    refinement = case['refinement']
    # build node->community map
    node_to_comm = refinement  # already a dict
    # gather all communities
    communities = set(refinement.values())
    # members dict: community -> list of nodes
    members = {c: [] for c in communities}
    # accumulate aggregate edges
    agg = {}  # key: (c1, c2) sorted tuple
    for u, v, w in edges:
        cu = node_to_comm[u]
        cv = node_to_comm[v]
        key = tuple(sorted((cu, cv)))
        agg[key] = agg.get(key, 0) + w
    # populate members
    for node, comm in refinement.items():
        members[comm].append(node)
    # sort each member list
    for c in members:
        members[c].sort()
    # build aggregate_edges list and sort
    aggregate_edges = [[c1, c2, total] for (c1, c2), total in agg.items()]
    aggregate_edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    return {'aggregate_edges': aggregate_edges, 'members': members}"}
